query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Shopify on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Shopify (Meeting 17 November 2026)

**Scope:** Sources dated roughly 21 October to 8 November 2026. Only the search results provided were used.

## Financial performance
- Shopify reported 32% revenue growth (32% in constant currency) and a 22% free cash flow margin for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, announced 3 November 2026 (https://www.shopify.com/investors/press-releases/shopify-sustains-rapid-growth-revenue-32-and-free-cash-flow). A Simply Wall St summary carried on Yahoo Finance repeats these figures (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/latest-news-e-commerce-shopifys-123733064.html).
- Management held a Q3 results call on 3 November 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET, with a webcast replay available (https://www.shopify.com/investors/press-releases/shopify-sustains-rapid-growth-revenue-32-and-free-cash-flow).

## Product launches
- Shopify's Fall '26 Edition was published on 1 November 2026 (https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-merchant). Highlights include a new Shop home on the web, with shoppable posts, editorial curations, and sections personalised to each shopper (https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-merchant).
- VP of Product Vanessa Lee frames the release around network effects across merchants (https://www.shopify.com/news/fall-26-edition-merchant).

## Promotions
- A third-party DemandSage page advertises three months of Shopify for $1/month, valid until 30 November 2026 (https://www.demandsage.com/shopify-free-trial). This is not an official Shopify source, and the terms are unverified.

## Headcount (timing unclear)
- An undated Tavily company profile lists headcount at 30,025, up 5,330 (21.6%) year on year, up 1,499 in the latest quarter, and up 170 in the latest month (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/yIg9BumgrtmF). Because the page is undated, these figures may fall outside the 30-day window.

## Hires and deals
- No hires, acquisitions, or partnership deals appear in the results. I could not find sources for these categories in the last 30 days.

## Open questions
1. What is the rollout timeline and merchant impact of the new Shop home and personalised sections announced in the Fall '26 Edition?
2. With revenue up 32% and headcount reportedly up 21.6% year on year, which areas are receiving the most investment in the next 12 months?
3. Are the $1/month, three-month trial terms available through official Shopify channels, and do they apply to the accounts we would bring to Shopify?
